title: Interval Decompositions for Multipersistence Modules over Finite Posets and Robustness of Sheaf Data on Simplicial Complexes
summary: We prove structure theorems for multipersistence modules indexed by finite posets that are not totally ordered. Specifically, we consider pointwise finite-dimensional modules over the opposite of the poset of non-empty subsets of a finite set, and give sufficient conditions, expressed through transition morphisms, for such modules to split as direct sums of interval modules. In the general case, the interval summands and multiplicities are explicitly determined by dimensions at finitely many indices.
